reviews.author: shashidhar savanth
reviews.body:
Very disappointed with PhonePe’s investment support.

I started a daily SIP on 15th July, investing ₹2,000 per day. The first installment was deducted, but none of the subsequent daily installments have been debited. The app still shows it as a daily investment, but there has been no explanation for why the payments have stopped.

The biggest issue is the customer support. I’ve tried contacting them through the in-app chat and by phone multiple times, but I haven’t been able to speak to a customer support executive or get a proper response.

I also had a poor experience with digital gold purchases earlier. The value of my investment appeared significantly lower immediately after purchase, and I couldn’t find a clear explanation of the charges or pricing. More transparency is needed so customers understand exactly what they’re paying.

When people invest their hard-earned money, they expect reliable service and responsive support. At the moment, I have very little confidence in using PhonePe for investments. Please improve your customer support and provide clear explanations for investment transactions.

reviews.author: CobraCommander39
reviews.body:
I am extremely disappointed with PhonePe's wallet support.

I successfully completed my PhonePe Wallet KYC and added ₹1,000 to my wallet. However, the app keeps showing "Verify Now", and whenever I tap it, I get a technical error. Because of this, I cannot use the money that I have already added.

I raised a support ticket on 7th July, and since then I've only been told to "wait 3 more days," then "wait another 2 days." Every time I contact customer support, they give me another waiting period instead of actually resolving the issue. It's been days, and there has been no real progress.

What's even more frustrating is that my money is effectively stuck due to a problem on their end, yet no one seems interested in fixing it. The support team keeps delaying instead of providing a solution or a clear timeline.

A digital payments company should not leave customers waiting for weeks to access their own money. Very poor customer service and a disappointing experience overall.

reviews.author: Perfect.click_22
reviews.body:
I am extremely disappointed with this app and the overall experience. I made a transaction, but due to a small mistake while entering the owner’s mobile number, the transaction got stuck in the verification process. The worst part is that there is no option to cancel the transaction or edit the incorrect details.

Instead of allowing users to simply cancel the transaction and create a new one with the correct information, the only solution provided was to wait for the transaction to fail and then wait 9–10 business days for the refund. This is completely unreasonable. A simple mistake should not force users to wait for weeks just to get their own money back.

Because of this, I am unable to complete the verification or create a new transaction immediately. The app lacks basic features like Cancel Transaction, Edit Details, or Retry Verification, which are essential for any platform handling important transactions.

The customer support experience was also disappointing. Rather than offering a practical solution, I was simply told to wait for the refund. This wastes users’ time, delays important work, and creates unnecessary frustration.

The developers seriously need to improve the user experience by allowing users to cancel pending transactions, correct mistakes, and process refunds much faster. Until these issues are fixed, I cannot recommend this app to anyone.

Very poor user experience. I expected much better from an app that handles important transactions.

Later, a PhonePe representative informed me that the machine was not a lifetime machine, had been issued in someone else’s name, and was worth much less than what I paid.

When I contacted PhonePe through its official support, I was asked to provide the employee’s ID card. As a customer, how can I have an employee’s ID card? If that person was part of PhonePe’s sales network, the company should verify its own records instead of asking customers for internal documents.

I lost ₹11,000 and did not receive the support I expected. I hope PhonePe investigates such complaints seriously and ensures that no other customer faces a similar experience.

reviews.body:
I am extremely disappointed with PhonePe’s approach to user privacy.

I fully support the requirement to retain financial transaction records for legal and regulatory purposes. However, there is absolutely no valid reason to deny users the ability to delete, hide, archive, or lock their personal chats and messages.

A transaction history is a financial record. A chat is a private conversation. These are two completely different things, and treating them as the same is unacceptable.

By forcing users to keep personal conversations permanently visible, PhonePe is taking away a basic level of privacy and control. Every user should have the freedom to manage their own conversations without affecting financial records.

Features such as Delete Chat, Hide Chat, Archive Chat, and Chat Lock are standard privacy options in many modern apps. The absence of these basic features in a leading payment platform is surprising and disappointing.

I urge the PhonePe team to stop ignoring user privacy and introduce these essential features as soon as possible. Until then, I cannot recommend this app to anyone who values privacy.

I switched to PhonePe because it has a large user base and strong merchant acceptance, but I feel the UI could be improved to make the experience better.

One suggestion is for the transaction history. Currently it mostly shows only the person or merchant name, which makes it harder to quickly recognize what type of payment it was. It would be very helpful if the history included clear icons or visual indicators for different types of transactions (for example petrol pump, grocery store, recharge, bill payment, etc.). This would make it much easier to scan through the history quickly, similar to how some other payment apps display transaction categories with icons.

The History tab itself could also be designed in a cleaner and more organized way so users can easily understand their past payments.

Another point is the ads and promotional banners. After completing a payment, the app often shows promotional screens or ads, which can feel a bit annoying. There are also many promotional sections inside the app which sometimes make the interface look cluttered.

Previously I was using another payment app which had a very clean and intuitive UI. I decided to try PhonePe mainly because of its market share and wide acceptance at merchants, but in terms of UI and user experience it sometimes feels less polished compared to other apps.

PhonePe is reliable for payments and widely used, but improving the UI, transaction history clarity, and reducing intrusive ads would make the app much better for everyday users.

reviews.author: Sangeeth SC
reviews.body:
I’ve used many financial apps, but this one stands out for all the wrong reasons. The core issue? Their customer service is completely irresponsible, and they refuse to take accountability when something goes wrong.

I recently attempted to transfer funds from my wallet to my bank account—something that should be a seamless process. Instead, the money never arrived. Naturally, I reached out to customer support, expecting some level of assistance. Instead, I was met with blame-shifting and excuses. Their response? “It’s your bank’s fault, not ours.”

Instead of investigating the issue, escalating the matter, or even offering a reasonable solution, they just washed their hands of the situation. Meanwhile, my bank confirmed they never received the funds, meaning the problem was entirely on the app’s side. Yet, the support team refused to acknowledge any possibility of error on their end.

A financial app that handles real money must be accountable for transactions, but this one clearly isn’t. If an issue arises, expect to be left in the dark while they pass the blame elsewhere. Until they take customer concerns seriously and stop deflecting responsibility, I strongly advise against using this app for any financial transactions.
